newsitem.title: UK: Unilever shares squeezed up to new high.
newsitem.headline: Unilever shares squeezed up to new high.

text.p: Shares in Anglo-Dutch food-to-detergents conglomerate Unilever Plc firmed in London on Monday, helped by a short squeeze which helped the stock break above recent resistance, dealers said.

"It looks like a chart break-out," said one dealer. The shares pushed above their previous intraday peak of 17.32 stg and were up 22p at 17.32-1/2 by 1450 GMT after climbing as high as 17.35 stg earlier.
"The shares have been a bit squeezy today," another dealer said. "Volume is fairly light but some people are short and have been looking for stock."

Dealers said interest was also being sparked by speculation on how the company would use the eight billion dollar proceeds from its sale of four speciality chemicals firms to Imperial Chemical Industries Plc.
ICI shareholders approved the deal on Monday.
The newspaper Sunday Business said Unilever was planning a bid for H.J. Heinz Co. "That would make a lot of strategic sense," one dealer said.
